layers.name: Elevation
layers.description: Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter global elevation, metres above the 1737.4 km reference sphere, 4 px/deg (about 7.6 km per pixel at the equator), detail view 16 px/deg (about 1.9 km). Source file: NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit ldem_4_uint.tif (uint16 half-metres).

layers.name: Hydrogen
layers.description: Hydrogen abundance (ppm by weight) inferred from epithermal neutron counts corrected with thermal neutrons (Feldman et al. 2001). Sensitive to the top ~1 m; the footprint is tens of km, so polar cold-trap ice is diluted. Not reliable where thorium / rare-earth elements are high (e.g. Procellarum KREEP terrane). Negative retrievals clipped to 0. [Source file: LP special product hydrogenhd.txt; 0.5 deg grid]

layers.name: Iron oxide (FeO)
layers.description: FeO weight percent from Lunar Prospector gamma-ray spectroscopy. High in mare basalts (ilmenite/pyroxene: feedstock for oxygen and iron extraction), low in feldspathic highlands. [Source file: LP special product ironhd.txt; 0.5 deg grid, already FeO wt%]

layers.name: Titanium oxide (TiO2)
layers.description: TiO2 weight percent from Lunar Prospector gamma-ray/neutron spectroscopy. Tracks ilmenite (FeTiO3), the classic ore for hydrogen-reduction oxygen production; ilmenite-rich regolith also retains more solar-wind volatiles. [Source file: PDS LP-L-GRS-5-ELEM-ABUNDANCE-V1.0 lpgrs_high1_elem_abundance_2deg.tab; 2 deg equal-area pixels, TiO2 weight fraction x100]

layers.name: Thorium
layers.description: Thorium abundance (ppm) from the 2.61 MeV gamma-ray line. Tracer of KREEP material (potassium, rare-earth elements, phosphorus) and of radiogenic heat-producing elements. [Source file: LP special product thoriumhd.txt; 0.5 deg grid]

layers.name: Potassium
layers.description: Potassium abundance (ppm) from Lunar Prospector gamma-ray spectroscopy; KREEP tracer. [Source file: LP special product potassium2d.txt; ~60 km bins]

layers.name: Magnesium oxide (MgO)
layers.description: MgO weight percent, Lunar Prospector GRS, 5 degree (~150 km) pixels. [Source file: PDS LP-L-GRS-5-ELEM-ABUNDANCE-V1.0 lpgrs_high1_elem_abundance_5deg.tab; 5 deg equal-area pixels, MgO weight fraction x100]

layers.name: Aluminium oxide (Al2O3)
layers.description: Al2O3 weight percent, Lunar Prospector GRS, 5 degree (~150 km) pixels. High in anorthositic highlands (aluminium / oxygen feedstock). [Source file: PDS LP-L-GRS-5-ELEM-ABUNDANCE-V1.0 lpgrs_high1_elem_abundance_5deg.tab; 5 deg equal-area pixels, Al2O3 weight fraction x100]

layers.name: Calcium oxide (CaO)
layers.description: CaO weight percent, Lunar Prospector GRS, 5 degree (~150 km) pixels. [Source file: PDS LP-L-GRS-5-ELEM-ABUNDANCE-V1.0 lpgrs_high1_elem_abundance_5deg.tab; 5 deg equal-area pixels, CaO weight fraction x100]

layers.name: Silicon dioxide (SiO2)
layers.description: SiO2 weight percent, Lunar Prospector GRS, 5 degree (~150 km) pixels (silicon for solar cells / glass). [Source file: PDS LP-L-GRS-5-ELEM-ABUNDANCE-V1.0 lpgrs_high1_elem_abundance_5deg.tab; 5 deg equal-area pixels, SiO2 weight fraction x100]

layers.name: Uranium
layers.description: Uranium abundance (ppm), Lunar Prospector GRS, 5 degree pixels. In the PDS product U is tied to thorium (U = 0.27 x Th), so it is not an independent measurement. [Source file: LP special product uranium5d.txt; 5 deg bins]

layers.name: Samarium
layers.description: Samarium abundance (micrograms per gram = ppm), Lunar Prospector, ~60 km bins. Rare-earth-element (KREEP) tracer. [Source file: LP special product samarium2d.txt; ~60 km bins]

layers.name: Epithermal neutron flux
layers.description: Epithermal neutron counts per 32 s, Lunar Prospector, ~60 km bins. LOWER counts mean more hydrogen in the top metre; this is the measurement the hydrogen map is derived from. [Source file: LP special product epis.txt; ~60 km bins]

albedo_info.description: LROC WAC colour map lroc_color_poles_4k.tif (NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit, LRO LROC WAC mosaic)
